verdict.rationale: mParticle's homepage claims users can "describe the audience, journey, or growth goal" in natural language, and the product then suggests the logic and helps activate it. That is a first-party natural-language capability, but it is limited to audience and journey building and supported only by marketing copy. No evidence shows natural-language control of the broader product, such as integrations, data quality, privacy, or identity setup. missing for 10: natural-language operation beyond audience/journey building, in-depth docs for the NL feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.
